newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Q1 corporate profits rose 4.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Q1 corporate profits rose 4.5 pct.

text.p: Commerce Department estimates of first quarter profits by U.S. corporations, with comparisons. Profits before tax include inventory valuation and capital consumption adjustments.
Data are chain-weighted and expressed in seasonally adjusted annual rates of billions of dollars, with first quarter percent changes from the fourth quarter.
R-Q4'96 Before Tax revised from 654.1, Q3'96 revised from 661.2 and 1996 revised from 654.0.

The department said the 4.5 percent increase in corporate profits was the largest since the first quarter of 1996 when profits rose 6 percent. The profit level, $426.5 billion, reached an all-time high, the department said.
